title: 고용노동부 소관 비상대비에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 고용노동부 소관 비상대비에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Designation of Enterprises Subject to Priority Management and Issuance of Mission Notice)
(1) Where the Minister of Employment and Labor designates an enterprise subject to priority management pursuant to Article 11 of the Act and Article 10 of the Decree, the Minister shall without delay issue to the head of the enterprise a Notice of Designation as an Enterprise Subject to Priority Management and Mission Notice in attached Form 1, and shall record and manage the fact in the Register of Issuance of Notices of Designation and Mission in attached Form 2 (hereinafter referred to as the "issuance register").
(2) Where the Minister of Employment and Labor changes the designation of an enterprise subject to priority management, the Minister shall notify the enterprise of the change and record it in the issuance register.
